notes.title: Optimization Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Optimized for more lower end PC's
Made Tutorials easy to understand
Made Controls clearer
Bug fixes
Made gameflow smooth

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes: Some smalls bug fixes including getting crashed in zombies even the distance is too close, boss stuck at one place, falling in void, monster in lab is less annoying, player can hear it's footsteps to avoid it, the interactable icon shows up for more distance than before making it easier to find items and interactables. more on the way...
